name: Basin-only scale curve (Neon free tier cannot hold these)
claim: Neon free tier caps at 512MB, so it cannot hold 1M+ of this workload — this curve is Basin-only. No-PK ingest scales FLAT (~68-85k rows/s held from 1M through 425M+ and counting), so 1B is bandwidth/time-bound (~3.3h from a single co-located loader), not architecture-bound. PK bulk-COPY, by contrast, slows super-linearly and is impractical past ~100M (per-chunk PK enforcement re-reads a growing file set — tracked separately). Cold first-touch reads climb with the file count as the working set outgrows cache.

rows.label: 425M+ sustained, ingest still flat (~68-85k rows/s, run continuing toward 1B)
1B: bandwidth-bound (~3.3h at flat ~85k rows/s, one co-located loader) — not architecture-bound; not run to completion in-window

note: Basin-only (dev, 8GB box). narrow_pk: 1M 230k rows/s (warm point 4.1 / range 4.4 / full_agg 6.8 ms), 10M 145k rows/s (cold point 53.6 / cold full_agg 225 ms); narrow_pk seed r/s declines super-linearly with table size (PK enforcement), impractical past ~100M. narrow_nopk: full_agg warm p50 2.0/2.0/3.9/11.4 ms at 10k/100k/1M/10M, seed throughput FLAT (~85k rows/s held 1M->100M), 100M seeded clean; the 1B row is NOT a measured number — at flat 85k rows/s a 1B narrow_nopk seed is ~3.3h from one loader (bandwidth-bound), left un-run in-window.
